eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 10:34 AM on AUG 26, 2021 Effective until 10:34 AM AUG 27, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with an evacuation warning for Hwy 70 at Massack, east to the east side of Lee Summit and everything north of those locations to the area of Argentine Rock and the south boundary of Zone 21. This includes Greenhorn and the north side of Spring Garden due to a wildfire. Make preparations to evacuate. If you have special needs you may want to evacuate now. If you have large animals you should make arrangements to move them immediately. If the situation changes, more alerts may be sent with new information. To view your evacuation zone, go to community .zonehaven.com
